title: Finite flat duality with an invertible target
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] morphism of Noetherian schemes and let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Write $f^!L$ for the right adjoint image of $L$ under $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]; it is a sheaf in degree zero. There is an $f_*\mathcal O_X$-linear isomorphism $f_*f^!L\cong\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(f_*\mathcal O_X,L)$, where $f_*\mathcal O_X$ acts on the right by precomposition with multiplication. Under this isomorphism the adjunction counit $f_*f^!L\to L$ is evaluation at $1$, and evaluation at $a$ of the image of $\omega$ equals evaluation at $1$ of the image of $a\omega$ for every local section $a$ of $f_*\mathcal O_X$ and $\omega$ of $f_*f^!L$.
